main:1.text: The Deku Tree is found east of Kokiri Forest. To reach there, however, Link must show Mido, who is blocking the way, the Deku Shield and Kokiri Sword. After that, Link approaches the dying deity, who talks to him about his situation, and enters. The Great Deku Tree contains five floors, of which three are over the surface and two are underground.

main:2.text: The cave is located about halfway up Death Mountain Trail. Prior to the events of the game, Ganondorf came to Death Mountain to get the Goron's Ruby from Darunia, the chief of the Gorons, who refused. Because of that, Ganondorf infested the cavern with Dodongos and sealed the entrance with a giant boulder.

main:3.text: The dungeon, unlike most others throughout the franchise, is set inside the body of Lord Jabu-Jabu, who spends every day on Zora's Fountain. To enter, Link must drop a Fish from his Bottle in front of Jabu-Jabu, causing him to widely open his mouth and suck both the fish and Link inside.

main:4.text: The Forest Temple is the first Dungeon that Link is directed to as an adult in Ocarina of Time. He must journey here to save his childhood friend, the Kokiri named Saria, only to awaken her to her role as the Sage of Forest. The primary item of the Temple is the Fairy Bow, and its boss is Phantom Ganon.

main:5.text: In Ocarina of Time, the Fire Temple is located deep within the Death Mountain Crater and is only accessible to Link as an adult by use of the Goron Tunic, which is given to him by Darunia's son, Link, in the hopes that he will rescue the other Gorons. Being in an active volcano, the Fire Temple is filled with many lava pits including the boss room.

main:6.text: The ancient temple lies deep under the vast Lake Hylia. Guarded by the Zoras, it is considered a sacred temple that is used to worship the water spirits. The Water Temple is accessible after the young hero finds the Iron Boots in Ice Cavern. Aided with the boots and the Hookshot, Link can access its entrance by shooting the target above the gate.

main:7.text: The Shadow Temple (OoT) is the seventh Dungeon in Ocarina of Time. Located in the back of the Kakariko Village Graveyard, it can be accessed once Link learns the Nocturne of Shadow. The Shadow Temple emphasizes macabre themes such as death and fear and arguably features the most terrifying enemies of the game.

main:8.text: Placed inside the Goddess of Sand, the temple is located in the westernmost area of the Desert Colossus in the Haunted Wasteland. It lies past the Gerudo Fortress. Constructed by the ancient ancestors of the Gerudo,  it served as Nabooru's headquarters until Ganondorf rose to power, becoming a base of operations for the King of Thieves and his surrogate mothers.

main:9.text: In Ocarina of Time, its prime association, Ganon's Castle is the final dungeon in the game and Ganon's stronghold, and replaces Hyrule Castle over the seven years that Link sleeps in suspended animation after he withdraws the Master Sword from its pedestal.
